summary: Jefferies Credit Partners BDC Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a routine monthly distribution declaration on its Class I and Class S common shares. Gross distribution is $0.1163 per share for both classes, with Class S reduced by a $0.0103 shareholder servicing/distribution fee to a net $0.1060. The distribution is payable September 18, 2026 to holders of record August 31, 2026, in cash or reinvested via the distribution reinvestment plan. This is an ordinary dividend declaration by a BDC, not a special situation; no strategic event or unusual corporate action is involved. Watch for continued regular monthly distributions.
